Behavioural Competency
Assessment

Company has identified the following activities/
areas or tasks where these competencies should
be assessed:
- Navigation

Mooring

Cargo Operations

Engineering Practices

Bunkering

Permit to Work (PTW) Enforcement

Watchkeeping

Other Activities

Rating levels for assessing competencies:
1- Unsatisfactory (does not meet expectations)

2- Needs improvement (sometimes meets
expectations)

3- Meets expectations (consistently meets
expectation)

4- Exceeds expectations (meets all and often
exceeds expectations)

5- Exceptional (consistently exceeds
expectations)
